verdict.rationale: Codegen documents a Linear integration that 'enable[s] agent interactions with your issues' and lists ticket support for Jira, Linear, ClickUp and Monday.com. An agent setting makes it respond to comments that explicitly mention it, which suggests tasks can be kicked off from an issue thread. However, the documented ticket actions are mostly output-side (updating statuses, commenting, linking PRs), and no page explicitly describes assigning or delegating an existing issue to the agent to start a coding run. Missing for 10: an explicit documented issue-assignment or delegation trigger flow, confirmation that this works across Jira/ClickUp/Monday and not only Linear, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
